integrity: The proof is analytic. Finite verification is corroborative and does not substitute for the infinite argument.
scientific_limitations: The exact result is restricted to crown graphs. The three-colour upper bound for n>=6 is already implied by arXiv:2608.04122; the new contribution is the two-colour rigidity, the unique n=4 exception, and the small-degree closure.
title: Exact strong-majority index of crown graphs
